payload.title: Epic Games cuts over 1,000 jobs as Tim Sweeney cites Fortnite revenue shortfall
payload.content: Epic Games has laid off over 1,000 employees — approximately 16% of its workforce. CEO Tim Sweeney shared the news with employees, acknowledging that Fortnite 'remains one of the most successful games in the world' but citing that Epic had been spending beyond its means. The cuts affected teams across the company including the Fortnite live operations team, leading Epic to announce the discontinuation of several Fortnite game modes.
